# The board example shows its five columns on a desktop, and the board first on a phone

## Context

The Engine 14 example slate (#21142) marks `examples/board/basic` "renew" (row 2 of the planning groups). The Kanban Board group gets its cover before Friday (#21146), and #20879 shows the board in the three themes. A visitor who opens the board example today does not see the board.

## The Problem

Measured at `dev` `74238ddcc5` in Chromium, through the component config's dev server:

- **1440 × 900:** the "All cards" table takes a fixed 420 px on the right (x 1020–1440). Of the five 280 px columns, Review is 47 % visible and Done is hidden.
- **390 × 844:** the table covers 366 of the 390 px. Backlog shows 4 %, and no other column shows at all.
- **The table is not the only cause.** At 1440, five columns at 280 px plus their gaps and the 12 px padding end at x 1460, so even a full-width board clips Done.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/board/basic/Viewport.mjs`: the body is an `hbox` holding the `BoardContainer` (`flex: 1`) beside a `width: 420` `vbox` with the "All cards" label and a `GridContainer`. Both views bind `stores.cards` from the view root's state provider. The example exists to show one store behind two views.
- The column width is the board family's token `--neo-board-column-width`, 280 px in `resources/css/theme-neo-dark/board/Container.css:14` and `theme-neo-light/board/Container.css:14`. `resources/css/src/board/Column.css:10–11` sizes each column from it. The Workstation sets 300 px for its own board (`resources/css/src/apps/workstation/Viewport.css:108`).
- The example's chrome is plain CSS in `resources/css/src/examples/board/basic/Viewport.css`, read from the board's own tokens, so every theme that styles the board styles the example too.

## The Fix

- **Desktop:** the table moves below the board, and the board takes the top. The example sets `--neo-board-column-width` on `.board-example` so that five columns fit 1440 px: at most 273 px, given 12 px of padding on each side and four 12 px gaps. The theme default stays as it is.
- **Phone:** the board comes first. Its columns scroll sideways at full width, and the table follows below it.
- Both views keep binding the one store, and a card moved on the board still updates its row. The toolbar's title and subtitle stay.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] At 1440 × 900, all five columns are fully in view on first paint, in `neo-theme-neo-light` and `neo-theme-neo-dark` (component or e2e spec reading the column boxes).
- [ ] At 390 × 844, the first screen shows the board, with at least the first column fully visible and no table over it (same spec).
- [ ] Moving a card to another column changes its row's status in the table, unchanged from today (existing behaviour, asserted in the same spec).
- [ ] Before and after frames at both sizes in the PR.

## Out of Scope

- The board family's default column width.
- The cover re-shoot: #21146's tile PR takes the board from this example once this lands.
- A second board with swimlanes (a separate slate lead on #21142).

## Avoided Traps

- **A narrower table beside the board:** five readable columns need about 1,400 px of the 1,440, so any side table clips one.
- **Shrinking the theme token for every board:** the Workstation and apps size their own boards, and the example has room for its own value.
